jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
**Software Developer**  
  
**Caltech**

**Job Category:** Parttime Term  
**Exempt Overtime Eligible:** Overtime Eligible  
**Benefits Eligible:** Benefit Based
  
  
Caltech is a world-renowned science and engineering institute that marshals some of the world's brightest minds and most innovative tools to address fundamental scientific questions. We thrive on finding and cultivating talented people who are passionate about what they do. Join us and be a part of the diverse Caltech community.  
  
**Job Summary**  
  
We're hiring a software developer to help build and maintain MathDB.
  
  
https://mathdb.com/
  
  
MathDB is a large-scale community database of definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems in mathematics, tracking the latest breakthroughs, and providing a new platform for research and collaboration. Mathematical knowledge is growing at an extraordinary pace. New results, methods and questions are arriving faster than the literature can absorb them, making it increasingly difficult to keep track of what is known, what remains open and how developments fit together. We need a shared database that grows with the subject: a living resource that the mathematical community can continually expand, correct and refine. Much of mathematical knowledge is scattered across papers, books, lecture notes and informal conversations. We aim to bring this knowledge together in a knowledge graph, connecting definitions, theorems, conjectures and open problems through implications, equivalences, examples and shared ideas. Making these relationships explicit can reveal connections that are otherwise easy to miss, help researchers navigate unfamiliar areas and accelerate the discovery of new mathematics. Formalization offers another way to make mathematical knowledge precise, reliable and reusable. We are integrating Lean formalizations and automatic proof verification into MathDB, connecting mathematical statements and their explanations with proofs that can be checked by a computer. Our goal is to make it easier to contribute formal proofs, inspect their assumptions and build on verified results, while keeping the relationship between a formal statement and its mathematical meaning clear.  
  
We're looking for someone who has experience building web apps and AI agents, and who can join our effort in building and maintaining web apps, mobile apps, backend servers, databases and Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**  

* Assist in the development and maintenance of interactive web and mobile applications for MathDB.
* Support the development and maintenance of backend servers for MathDB.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of MathDB's backend database infrastructure.
* Support the development and maintenance of Lean formalization pipelines for MathDB.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience developing interactive web and mobile applications.
* Strong attention to detail in application design, performance, responsiveness, visual presentation, and user interface/user experience (UI/UX).
* Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and incorporate feedback through an iterative development process.
* Experience with version control, software testing, and software engineering best practices.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and delivering polished, production-ready software products beyond the prototype stage.
* Familiarity with cloud computing, containerization, and orchestration technologies.
* Strong interest in mathematical research.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with users and colleagues.
* Familiarity with Lean formalization.

  
**Required Documents**  

* Resume.

  
  
  
**To be considered for this position please visit our web site and apply on line at the following link:** **https://hr.caltech.edu/work/job\_openings**  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: Gameplay Tools Engineer
jobs.description:
At Gardens Interactive, we're building games centered on connection, collective adventure, and emergent stories. We believe the spirit with which we build games is reflected in the experiences our players have. The way we collaborate, solve problems, navigate uncertainty, and care for one another ultimately shapes the worlds we create. We're creating magical, shared experiences that bring players together and we know those experiences come from teams that are curious, resilient, ambitious, and deeply committed to one another.

We're a fully remote studio that embraces collaboration, thoughtful iteration, and the courage to explore new ideas. If you're excited by ambiguity, enjoy solving difficult problems with kind, talented teammates, and want to help build worlds where friendships flourish, we'd love to meet you.

As a Gameplay Tools Engineer, you will create custom Unreal Engine tools that support teams across the studio. You will partner with stakeholders to understand the unique needs of their iteration workflows and author bespoke tools using C++ within the Unreal editor and in-game environments that will accelerate those pipelines. You will be a force-multipler for the team, enabling rapid exploration of new features and comprehensive analysis of and decision-making regarding the breadth of content that powers the emergent interactions of our games.

**A Day in the Life:**
======================

* Craft tools that support other disciplines (including art, audio, design) in efficient content creation, iteration and analysis.
* Work with individual developers to build features that can reduce manual effort and accelerate workflows.
* Playtest regularly with the team to understand the creative spaces our games are operating within in order to better support the team.

**What You’ll Do:**
===================

* Own the technical architecture and implementation of multiple tools and supporting systems across the game, partnering closely with stakeholders and the production team to improve iteration throughput.
* Collaborate closely with audio, VFX and design stakeholders to understand the needs of their development pipelines and proactively create solutions that will allow content production at scale.
* Act as a technical bridge between gameplay and backend engineering teams to aid in the development of analysis and diagnostics systems across all aspects of our games.
* Contribute to the stability of the game by proactively assisting in the identification and triage of issues in game systems, collaborating on solutions, and reducing friction in the development process.

**What You’ll Bring:**
======================

* 3+ years of experience building game tools across one or more projects.
* Experience building customized tools via the Unreal editor’s extension mechanisms.
* Familiarity with Wwise or similar audio middleware.
* Experience working closely with VFX systems and artists.
* Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the judgment to work independently, recognize constraints, and seek support when needed.

**Nice to Haves:**
==================

* Previous experience on shipped multiplayer titles using Unreal Engine.
* Prior experience owning the decision-making and implementations of significant portions of the tools ecosystem of a game or engine.
* Experience profiling and optimizing gameplay, engine or infrastructure systems for large-scale content.

**The Team:**
=============

* You will report to the Lead Gameplay engineer.
* You will join a team of gameplay engineers who work closely with other disciplines to champion the values that our games are centered on.

**How We Work**

We believe great games are built by people who care deeply about both the work and one another. Our values guide how we collaborate, solve problems, make decisions, and grow together. They're practical behaviors, not slogans, and they're part of how we hire, give feedback, and support one another every day.

We're looking for teammates who are excited to:

* Stay curious and ask thoughtful questions.
* Adapt when plans change.
* Exercise good judgment rather than chase perfection.
* Care for the success of the whole team, not just their own work.
* Pursue ambitious goals while remaining humble enough to keep learning.
* Commit fully to the shared adventure we're building together.

**You'll Thrive Here If...**

* You enjoy asking questions before jumping to conclusions.
* You adapt comfortably when priorities evolve.
* You balance ambition with pragmatism.
* You communicate thoughtfully and seek feedback.
* You care about helping your teammates succeed.
* You embrace uncertainty as part of creating something new.

**Please Note:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States or Canada. Gardens cannot assist with work authorizations or work visas. Applicants must also be willing to work within North American time zones (EST–PST).

**Our Interview Process**

(all interviews are 1 hour video calls on Google Meet unless otherwise noted)

* Step 1: People Operations Introduction
* Step 2: Hiring Manager Interview
* Step 3: Panel Interview (3 - 1 Hour Sections)
* Step 4: Gardeners Debrief
* Step 5: Offer

**Life at Gardens**

Gardens is a fully distributed game studio founded by creators behind titles including Journey, What Remains of Edith Finch, Blaseball, Dustforce, Ashen, Guild Wars 2, Baldur’s Gate 3, and more.

We're developing our flagship project: a multiplayer fantasy adventure inspired by the friendships, discoveries, and unforgettable stories that emerge when people explore together.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with diverse experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and ways of thinking. Every Gardener helps shape not only what we build, but how we build it.

Each of us arrives by a different path, bringing unique experiences, perspectives, and ways of seeing the world. That range is part of what makes our games and our studio better than any one of us

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**WHAT WE'RE DOING**  
  
Come join the EADGE-T team and be part of an effort to upgrade the program’s technology and bring new capabilities to the UAE customer. The EADGE-T system is an integrated air missile defense, air battle management capability for the UAE integrating existing sensors, weapons as well as new capabilities.  
  
The Tech Refresh will focus on Foundational / Cyber Security Enhancements. Join us and become a part of the team that is actively designing and developing the updated baseline and get the opportunity to work with an international customer!  
  
**THE WORK**  
  
EADGE-T is seeking a software engineer to join one of the agile development teams. In this role, you will:

* Decompose higher-level roadmap features into actionable work items
* Design, Implement, and integrate/test software features
* Perform peer reviews for fellow software engineers and debug issues as they arise
* Participate in technical discussions to define/solve overarching software architecture needs
* Collaborate with cross-functional peers to better understand project requirements and customer/stakeholder needs

**WHO WE ARE**  
  
EADGE-T has a geographically dispersed project team that executes in an agile – scrum setting.  
  
Team members have the ability to interface with an international customer and learn more about the technologies and processes being developed for this upgrade. If the desire to succeed in a challenging and complex problem space excites you, EADGE-T may be the perfect venture!  
  
**WHY JOIN US**  
  
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life - At Lockheed Martin, we prioritize the well-being of our employees. We offer flexible schedules, competitive pay, and a comprehensive benefits package to support your healthy, fulfilling life both at and outside of work

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Proficiency with Python and Java
* RHEL/Windows experience
* Experience working in agile environments (Kanban/Scrum)
* Experience across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
* Proficiency with version control and collaboration tools (e.g. Git, GitLab, Jira, Confluence)
* Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles
* Experience with automated testing and continuous integration (unit tests, CI/CD pipelines)
* 3+ years of relevant work experience (An advanced degree may be substituted for up to 2 years of work experience)

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Experience with Services, Microservices, Software Factories, Cloud-native and Service-Oriented Architectures
* Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
* Strong background in CI/CD tooling (Git, GitLab, Jenkins) and automated testing frameworks
* Experience with test-driven development, continuous integration, and regression testing expertise
* Cybersecurity knowledge for software products (user authentication, data encryption) and secure development handling of classified information
* Active Secret Clearance

**Pay Information**

**GeoZone Definition:** GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $101400.00 - $188200.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $91200.00 - $169400.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $81100.00 - $150500.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
* Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $72900.00 - $135500.00
  + Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.  
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities.
  
We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.  
  
**Your Future Team**  
The mission of Atlassian is to unleash potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together. AI/ML is significantly transforming how teams come together to plan, track, and deliver work across software and business teams using our products. We are looking for rockstar Machine learning engineers to come help us to further this mission and help make teams more productive leveraging AI across our product portfolio.

Responsibilities:

**What you'll do**  
  
As a Machine Learning engineer, you will work on the development and implementation of the cutting edge machine learning algorithms, training models, collaborating with product, engineering, and analytics teams, to build the AI functionalities into each Atlassian products and services.
  
  
Your daily responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks such as designing system and model architectures, conducting rigorous experimentation and model evaluations.
  
  
You will be responsible for application of AI/ML to various product problems to improve Atlassian products and actively contribute toAtlassian Intelligence features.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $178,200 - $232,650

**Zone B**: $160,380 - $209,385

**Zone C**: $147,906 - $193,100

Qualifications:

**On your first day, we’ll expect you to have**  
  
Bachelor's or Master's degree (preferably a Computer Science degree or equivalent experience).  
  
Expertise in Python or Java with and the ability to write performant production-quality code, familiarity with SQL.  
  
Knowledge of Spark and cloud data environments is a plus (e.g. AWS, Databricks)  
  
Experience building and scaling machine learning models using large amounts of data  
  
Experience working in a consumer or B2C space for a SaaS product provider, or the enterprise/B2B space  
  
Experience in developing deep learning-based models and working on LLM-related applications  
  
Excelling in solving ambiguous and complex problems, being able to navigate through uncertain situations, breaking down complex challenges into manageable components and developing innovative solutions  
  
**Compensation**  
  
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. To support this goal, the baseline of our range is higher than that of the typical market range, but in turn we expect to hire most candidates near this baseline.
  
Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience.
  
  
In the United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:  
Zone A: $178,200 - $232,650  
Zone B: $160,380 - $209,385  
Zone C: $147,906 - $193,100  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.  
Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones (http://go.atlassian.com/payzones) for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.  
  
**Our perks & benefits**  
Atlassian offers a variety of perks and benefits to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community.  
Our offerings include health coverage, paid volunteer days, wellness resources, and so much more. Visit (http://go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits) to learn more.  
  
**About Atlassian**  
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be  
impossible alone, possible together.

Atlassian’s Gen AI Platform team builds the shared foundation for creating, deploying, and operating production AI agents. We provide reusable runtimes, APIs, tools, plugins, and operational capabilities so product teams can focus on customer experiences.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable backend systems and platforms that make other engineers more effective.

Responsibilities:

* Build and operate backend services, APIs, libraries, and developer tools for our agent platform.
* Own well-defined capabilities from design through testing, rollout, and production support.
* Develop stable, self-service interfaces for defining agents, connecting tools, and extending platform behaviour.
* Improve reliability, performance, observability, and developer experience.
* Investigate failures across distributed services and agent execution flows.
* Collaborate with product and platform teams and participate in code and design reviews.
* Participate in on-call and turn operational learning into lasting improvements.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $150,300 - $196,225

**Zone B**: $135,270 - $176,603

**Zone C**: $124,749 - $162,867

Qualifications:

* Experience building and operating production backend or platform services.
* Proficiency in a language such as TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.
* Understanding of APIs, asynchronous processing, data storage, cloud infrastructure, and testing.
* Sound judgment around correctness, reliability, maintainability, and delivery trade-offs.
* Strong learning agility and clear communication.

Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, MCP, developer platforms, distributed runtimes, or Kubernetes is desired but not required.

Overview/ Job Responsibilities:

Entarian is seeking a Software Developer - Space Weather Scientific Software to support the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Space Warfare Directorate.

**Responsibilities include, but not limited to:**

* Researching and developing space weather science phenomenology modeling, prediction, and forecast from science algorithms/prototypes into operational software applications, and advancing current R2O practices in methodology, processes, tools, etc.
* Hands-on coding as well as technical management of interacting with customers.
* Designing, developing, integrating, and maintaining space weather science applications and perform full life-cycle software development activities.

Work is located at Kirtland AFB in Albuquerque, NM, but can be performed remotely with travel to Kirtland AFB up to 2 times per year up to 2-3 weeks.

Salary range: $110,000.00 - $122,000.00

Minimum Qualifications:

* US Active Secret level clearance
* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in general software engineering development in delivering mission-critical system applications, preferably science-based systems supporting NOAA/NASA/DoD
* Familiarity with AGILE software development practices with the ability to use and maintain make-based build tools and SCM-Git for large-scale and distributed software development
* Experience in developing with C/Fortran/C++, and Python in Linux environments
* Excellent verbal written communications skills
* Must be self-motivated and adaptable in a dynamic hybrid R&D and production environment
* Experience in developing Cloud-native applications and helping to mature DevSecOps and Platform Engineering practices
* Ability to rescue/reverse-engineer troubled scientific code
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and gathering detailed user requirements

Desired Qualifications:

* Master's degree
* Experience or background in space weather science
* Javascript/HTML/CSS web programming experience
* Knowledge in conducting and managing system-level testing
* Knowledgeable about information assurance practices in compliance with best practices security policies and procedures
* Familiarity with research-2-operations (R2O) methodology
* GitOps, and other foundational AWSGovCloud technology

About Us:

Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. We don't just support modernization; we define it.

**Join the Mission and Start your Career Journey:** Apply Directly via our Careers Portal **Connect,** **Referrals & Inquiries?** **Email the team:** **careers@entarian.com**

*Entarian is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.*

jobs.description:
**Greater software infrastructure across the country. Deliver the change today.**

**Software Developer**

Remote in the US

**About the role**

Passionate about software design? Your next role could deliver the software that powers a smart, inclusive, and sustainable future for higher education. We’re on the lookout for an enthusiastic and personable Software Developer who can help us build, support, and enhance the software that our college and university customers rely on every day.

**What you’ll be doing**

As part of the Managed IT Services team, you’ll be involved in the design, development, and support of software solutions used across a variety of higher education use cases. It’s a role with a lot of variety, and day-to-day, you’ll mainly be involved with:

  

* Building and maintaining integrations between data systems, typically connecting ERP/SIS platforms with SaaS applications
* Developing custom web applications that support specific college and university business needs
* Creating software and solutions that monitor and automate our managed hosting services
* Developing identity management and user provisioning automation
* Supporting, troubleshooting, and enhancing existing applications and integrations throughout the software development lifecycle
* Building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code to deploy solutions across AWS, OCI, Azure, and Kubernetes environments
* Using AI-assisted development tools to improve the speed and quality of delivery

**What you’ll bring**

Think you could make a difference here? We’re looking for a developer who takes pride in building reliable, well-designed software and wants to make an impact from day one. You’ll have solid, hands-on experience across the following:

  

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in professional software development.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Proficiency in programming and scripting languages: Python, Java, SQL, Bash, and PowerShell.
* Experience with version control using Git.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms and build and deployment automation.
* Experience developing for the cloud on AWS, OCI, or Azure, including containerized workloads on Kubernetes.
* Experience with infrastructure as code tools: AWS CDK/CloudFormation and Terraform.
* Experience using AI-assisted software development tools.

The following experience is preferred:

  

* Experience in higher education, and working with ERP/SIS platforms such as Ellucian Banner.
* Experience with web development and user interface design, including frameworks such as React.

**About us**

At Boldyn Networks, we’re reimagining the future of interconnectivity. Our network solutions are solving some of tomorrow’s greatest challenges. We are one team across the globe. Always listening. Learning. We value different perspectives and challenge each other to be our best. Here, you can change lives today and create a better tomorrow.

**Why work with us?**

We’re large enough to deliver and maintain large-scale operations, giving you the opportunity to work on exciting projects and expand your skills. You’ll be surrounded by talented colleagues who thrive on solving problems, just like you. Together, you’ll make your mark on projects that matter and find new strengths along the way.

**We also offer:**

* Salary: $110,000 - $130,000 per year

* Annual bonus
* Learning Development Opportunities
* Flexible working opportunities
* Competitive benefit packages
* Paid Parental Leave
* Vacation starting at 15 days and increasing with length of service
* 10 days paid sick leave
* 4 days off each year to volunteer

**Ready to apply?**

Are you ready to create an impact that will last for generations? Join us at Boldyn Networks today. Hit apply and follow the instructions to get started.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

We celebrate diversity in all its forms. Our backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us stronger. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, age, gender, background, or religion. Together, we’ll solve customer challenges in the smartest ways possible.

jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description:
**About Jorie:**

Jorie AI, occupies a uniquely interconnected position at the center of the healthcare industry. An inseparable part of today's healthcare billing ecosystem, with leading edge technology that is driving transformation with AI infused Robotic Process Automation for end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management, providing practice and financial management services to the healthcare industry. Applied Intelligence, Better Insight, Accelerated Efficiencies with Jorie AI.

**Our work environment:**

Growth advancement opportunities

Flexible work environment (Work-life Balance)

Collaborative and friendly company culture

**Great Benefits:**

401(k) matching up to 4%

Medical

Dental

Vision

Long/Short Term Disability insurance

Life insurance $25,000 Paid by employer

PTO 2 weeks

10 and half Holidays

We are seeking a Software Engineer I to build and maintain intelligent automation for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) in healthcare. You will develop Python automation that works across EHR systems, payer portals, and internal services. You will learn healthcare billing workflows and build your skills in Selenium, computer vision, web services, and cloud technology. You will work closely with senior engineers and get regular code review and mentorship, and you will own real production work from early on.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Automation Development:** Build and maintain automation for RCM processes using Python, Selenium, and OpenCV.
* **Web Automation:** Automate browser tasks such as data extraction, form submission, and portal navigation.
* **Computer Vision and OCR:** Use OpenCV and OCR to read and interact with screens and documents in desktop and web applications.
* **Production Support:** Monitor running automations. Investigate failures using logs, screenshots, and database records, then fix the cause.
* **Data and SQL:** Write SQL queries to look at task queues, results, and exceptions, and to support reporting.
* **Services and APIs:** Help build and maintain internal APIs, dashboards, and integrations with payers, clearinghouses, and EHR systems.
* **Collaboration:** Work with operations teams and SMEs to understand manual workflows and turn them into reliable automation.
* **Compliance and Security:** Follow HIPAA requirements, secure credential handling, and logging and audit practices in all development work.
* **Documentation:** Write and maintain technical documentation for the workflows you build.
* **Cloud Services:** Use Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Key Vault) as part of the automation infrastructure.

  

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 1 year of professional software development experience, or equivalent academic or project experience.
* Working proficiency in Python.
* Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
* Experience with Git and a standard pull request workflow.
* Strong analytical and debugging skills, and close attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.
* Interest in healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., eligibility, authorizations, claims, denials).

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience with Selenium, Playwright, or another browser automation tool.
* Web development experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks.
* Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
* Exposure to OpenCV, OCR (e.g., Tesseract), or image processing.
* Experience with automated testing (e.g., pytest).
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform.
* Exposure to Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or PowerShell scripting in Windows environments.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards (X12 EDI 270/271, HL7) or EHR systems.
* Experience using AI/ML or LLM tools in real projects.
* Awareness of logging, monitoring, and observability tools (e.g., Grafana).

**Must be legally authorized to work in the USA. No Contractors, No C2C, No Visa Sponsorship**

**No recruiting agencies.**

Location & Hours:

Remote in USA Only. We cannot consider candidates from New York, California, or Washington state

Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 5:00 PMCST

Flexible working hours may be required based on business

**Jorie AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.**

**Overview**

We are seeking a Software Engineer II to build and own intelligent automation for Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) in healthcare. With limited supervision, you will take features and automation workflows from requirements through to production. The work spans EHR systems, payer portals, clearinghouses, and internal services. You will partner with operations teams to turn manual workflows into reliable automation. You will also help Software Engineer I teammates grow through code review and pairing.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Automation Development:** Design, build, and maintain automation for RCM processes using Python, Selenium, and OpenCV, with limited supervision.
* **Feature Ownership:** Take features from requirements through design, implementation, testing, and production release.
* **Computer Vision and OCR:** Build reliable screen and document recognition with OpenCV and OCR, including handling popups, timing issues, and layout changes.
* **Production Support:** Own the health of the automations you build. Find the root cause of failures from logs, screenshots, and database records, and fix them so they don't come back.
* **Data and SQL:** Write and tune SQL for task queues, reporting, and analysis of throughput and exceptions.
* **Services and APIs:** Build and maintain internal APIs, services, and integrations with payers, clearinghouses, and EHR systems.
* **Requirements and Estimation:** Work with SMEs and operations to break manual workflows into steps that can be automated, flag edge cases early, and estimate the effort.
* **Code Quality:** Write tests, review code, and keep automations maintainable.
* **Compliance and Security:** Maintain secure credential handling, logging, and audit trails in line with HIPAA and HITRUST requirements.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain technical documentation for the workflows you own.
* **Cloud Services:** Build on Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Key Vault) to support scalable automation.
* **Mentorship:** Support Software Engineer I teammates through code review, pairing, and technical guidance.

  

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 3 years of professional software development experience.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including maintainable, tested production code.
* Hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright, or another browser automation tool.
* Proficiency with SQL and relational databases.
* Experience building or integrating with REST APIs.
* Experience debugging and supporting software in production.
* Proficiency with Git, including branching and code review.
* Working knowledge of healthcare RCM workflows (e.g., eligibility, authorizations, claims, denials), or of a similarly complex business domain.
* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical teammates.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Web development experience with FastAPI, Flask, Django, or similar frameworks.
* Production experience with OpenCV, OCR, or image processing.
* Experience automating healthcare revenue cycle workflows.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards (X12 EDI 270/271, HL7) or EHR systems.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Functions, Key Vault, App Services) or another cloud platform.
* Experience with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* PowerShell scripting and Windows environment experience.
* Experience with background jobs, task queues, or concurrent processing.
* Automated testing experience (e.g., pytest), including mocking external systems.
* Experience applying AI/ML or LLM tools to production problems.
* Experience with logging, alerting, and observability tools (e.g., Grafana).

  

**Must be legally authorized to work in the USA. No Contractors, No C2C, No Visa Sponsorship**

**No recruiting agencies.**

Location & Hours:

Remote in USA Only. We cannot consider candidates from New York, California, or Washington state

Mon-Fri 8:00 AM to 5:00 PMCST

Flexible working hours may be required based on business

**Jorie AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.**

jobs.title: RHEL - Sr. Full Stack Engineer - FT Telework
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

**WHAT WE’RE DOING**  
  
Come join the EADGE-T team and be part of an effort to upgrade the program’s technology and bring new capabilities to the UAE customer. The EADGE-T system is an integrated air missile defense, air battle management capability for the UAE integrating existing sensors, weapons as well as new capabilities.  
  
The Tech Refresh will focus on Foundational / Cyber Security Enhancements. Join us and become a part of the team that is actively designing and developing the updated baseline and get the opportunity to work with an international customer!  
  
**THE WORK**  
  
EADGE-T is seeking a full stack engineer to join the project team as an infrastructure engineer with a focus on RedHat Enterprise Linux Systems. In this role, you will:

  

* Decompose high level roadmap/project milestones into actionable work items
* Design and develop IT solutions across all components of software systems
* Provide Infrastructure-related to support to the various project teams
* Utilize knowledge of software engineering, cybersecurity, system integration, and data management to ensure project deliverables meet overarching system requirements
* Collaborate with cross-functional peers to better understand project requirements and customer/stakeholder needs

Note: This position is located in Colorado Springs, CO. *Highly* qualified candidates will be considered for the potential to work remotely.

**WHO WE ARE**  
  
EADGE-T has a geographically dispersed project team that executes in an agile – scrum setting.  
  
Team members have the ability to interface with an international customer and learn more about the technologies and processes being developed for this upgrade. If the desire to succeed in a challenging and complex problem space excites you, EADGE-T may be the perfect venture!  
  
**WHY JOIN US**  
  
Your Health, Your Wealth, Your Life – At Lockheed Martin, we prioritize the well-being of our employees. We offer flexible schedules, competitive pay, and a comprehensive benefits package to support your healthy, fulfilling life both at and outside of work

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Experience deploying, configuring, patching, and sustaining RHEL 9 or comparable Linux Distros
* Experience automating Linux provisioning and administration using Ansible, Bash, Python, and RHEL Kickstarts
* Experience implementing DISA STIGs and remediating Nessus or SCAP vulnerability findings on enterprise Linux systems
* Current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II or higher certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, SSCP, CCNA Security, or CISSP
* Experience performing detailed test planning, technical system integration, verification and validation, and operational documentation
* 5+ years of relevant work experience (An applicable advanced degree may be substituted for up to 2 years of relevant work experience)

**Desired Skills**
------------------

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator, Red Hat Certified Engineer, or Red Hat Ansible Automation certification
* Experience supporting RHEL virtual desktop pools or Linux workloads in Omnissa Horizon environments
* Experience engineering PostgreSQL high availability using Patroni, etcd, Consul, pgBackRest, WAL-G, synchronous or asynchronous replication, quorum, and split-brain prevention
* Experience using REST APIs, SDKs, or infrastructure-management interfaces to integrate Linux services with enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell, and cross-platform operational dependencies
* Experience creating production-grade automation for health monitoring, system baselining, security remediation, and unattended deployment
* Active Secret Clearance

**Pay Information**

Full-Time Salary Range: $98100.00 - $182100.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

**Benefits offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview:

Atlassian’s Gen AI Platform team builds the shared foundation for creating, deploying, and operating production AI agents. We provide reusable runtimes, APIs, tools, plugins, and operational capabilities so product teams can focus on customer experiences.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable backend systems and platforms that make other engineers more effective.

Responsibilities:

* Build and operate backend services, APIs, libraries, and developer tools for our agent platform.
* Own well-defined capabilities from design through testing, rollout, and production support.
* Develop stable, self-service interfaces for defining agents, connecting tools, and extending platform behaviour.
* Improve reliability, performance, observability, and developer experience.
* Investigate failures across distributed services and agent execution flows.
* Collaborate with product and platform teams and participate in code and design reviews.
* Participate in on-call and turn operational learning into lasting improvements.

Pay Ranges:

In The **United States**, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

**Zone A**: $150,300 - $196,225

**Zone B**: $135,270 - $176,603

**Zone C**: $124,749 - $162,867

Qualifications:

* Experience building and operating production backend or platform services.
* Proficiency in a language such as TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.
* Understanding of APIs, asynchronous processing, data storage, cloud infrastructure, and testing.
* Sound judgment around correctness, reliability, maintainability, and delivery trade-offs.
* Strong learning agility and clear communication.

Experience with AI agents, LLM applications, MCP, developer platforms, distributed runtimes, or Kubernetes is desirable but not required.
